title: 8 Things a Godly Man Stopped Negotiating With
caption:
8 things a godly man stopped negotiating with. He killed them instead of managing them.

The "just this once" voice. The private tab. The snooze button on prayer. The friend who only shows up when you're winning. The grudge he's been calling discernment. The apology with a but attached. The comparison scroll before bed. And the excuse that starts with I'm just wired this way.

You don't manage what's killing you. You put it to death.

#faith #discipline #godlymen #christianman #selfcontrol #sin #manofgod
